rice.content: Apply Rice Reap (5 kg/ha) at booting and again after 10 days to improve spikelet fertility, grain filling, and yield.
Apply Rice Bloom (5 kg/ha) at heading and grain filling stages with wetting agent.
Apply Zinc Solubilizing Bacteria (2 L/ha) + Zinc Sulphate (25 kg/ha) + RDF for improved zinc nutrition and drought resilience.
Bacillus altitudinis FD48 improves drought resilience under stress conditions.
Follow Alternate Wetting and Drying from 21 DAS to 10 days before harvest with 125% RDF.
Incorporate stubble using TNAU Biomineralizer (2 kg/t) with urea.
Spray Azoxystrobin + Propiconazole @ 500 ml/ha at tillering and booting stages for disease control.
Apply FD48 seed treatment @ 125 ml/ha before sowing.
Apply FD48 foliar spray @ 500 ml/ha at 30 DAS.
Apply FD48 foliar spray @ 500 ml/ha at 50 DAS.
Use stage-specific inoculants containing Azospirillum, Azotobacter, Phosphobacteria, Potash bacteria, Pseudomonas, and PPFM.
Use Zinc Solubilizing Bacterial Biofertilizer to improve Zn nutrition and increase yield.
Apply TNAU Micronutrient Mixtures for wetland and rainfed rice to improve quality and yield.
Use Nanosci Lure for eco-friendly monitoring and mass trapping of yellow stem borer.
Use TNAU Biomineralizer (2 kg/tonne) for in-situ rice straw decomposition.

maize.content: Apply Neem cake @ 250 kg/ha for nutrient and soil management.
Apply Zn citrate (0.5%) and Fe citrate (1%) foliar sprays at 30 DAS in deficient soils.
Apply Zn citrate (0.5%) and Fe citrate (1%) foliar sprays at 40 DAS in deficient soils.
Apply Zn citrate (0.5%) and Fe citrate (1%) foliar sprays at 50 DAS in deficient soils.
Treat seeds with Thiamethoxam 30 FS @ 10 ml/kg for FAW management.
Maintain spacing of 60 × 25 cm with rogue rows every 10 rows.
Use border crops like cowpea and gingelly and intercrop with blackgram.
Install pheromone traps (50/ha) and solar traps (1/ha) for FAW monitoring.
At early whorl stage apply Emamectin benzoate, Chlorantraniliprole, Flubendiamide, or Azadirachtin.
At late whorl stage apply Metarhizium anisopliae, Emamectin benzoate, Novaluron, or Spinetoram.
At tasseling/cob formation stage use insecticides not used earlier.
Release Telenomus remus @ 1.25 lakh/ha for biological control.

cotton.content: Use high density planting with spacing of 90 × 15 cm for 29,629 plants/acre using varieties like Suraksha, CO-17, and VPT-2.
Apply fertilizer dose of 100:50:50 kg NPK/ha.
Apply Pendimethalin 38.7% CS @ 700 ml/acre within 24-48 hours of sowing.
Spray NAA @ 40 ppm or Cotton Plus @ 2.5 kg/acre for growth management.
Apply Mepiquat Chloride (0.015%) at square/flowering stage.
Apply sodium chlorate (0.9%) or Drop Ultra as defoliant at 60% boll burst.
Use paired row planting (45/90 × 30 cm) of Bt Cotton with two rows of cluster bean.
Application of Mepiquat Chloride and Sodium Chlorate improves suitability of CO 17 for mechanical harvesting.

coconut.content: Install yellow sticky traps (20/ha or 8/ac), use trunk banding, and spray jet water on fronds.
Release Apertochrysa astur (1000/ha) and Encarsia spp. (250/ha or 100/ac) for biological control.
Apply FYM (50 kg) + neem cake (5 kg) + fertilizers along with bio-agents like Trichoderma, Bacillus, Phosphobacteria, Azospirillum, and VAM.
Apply CuSO4 (200 g) and MgSO4 (1 kg) alternately.
Apply TNAU Coconut Tonic (40 ml twice/year) for improved palm vigour and nut yield.
Apply IIHR Arka Decomposer for rapid composting of coconut residues and improved soil health.
Apply COCOCON drench @ 2 L/tree every 2 months.
Apply crown spray of hexaconazole when required.
Use Copra Guard nano-formulation (10 ml/litre) to control fungal growth on copra.

chilli.content: Treat seeds with Bacillus subtilis @ 10 g/kg before sowing.
Use three-row maize barrier and install yellow sticky traps @ 12/ha.
Apply and spray micronutrient mixture containing Fe, Zn, Cu, Mn, and B.
Rogue virus infected plants up to 45 DAT.
Apply Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 3 ml/10 L and Pyriproxyfen 10% EC @ 1 ml/L alternately.
Spray Azoxystrobin 18.2% + Difenoconazole 11.4% SC @ 0.1% three times at 15-day intervals.
Use border crops like cowpea, lab-lab, and coriander with bird perches (20/ha), sticky traps (20/ha), and pheromone traps (12/ha).
Use need-based foliar sprays with Azadirachtin 1%, NSKE 5%, 3G extract 5%, five-leaf extract 10%, and Bacillus subtilis 0.5%.

banana.content: Apply emamectin benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L through pseudo stem injector during 5th month for insect management.
Apply emamectin benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L through pseudo stem injector during 6th month for insect management.
Apply emamectin benzoate 5 SG @ 0.4 g/L through pseudo stem injector during 7th month for insect management.
Perform seedling bio-hardening using Bacillus velezensis + Brachybacterium paraconglomeratum (1% consortia) twice fortnightly.
Apply soil drenching @ 0.5 L/plant using microbial consortia during 2nd month.
Apply soil drenching @ 0.5 L/plant using microbial consortia during 4th month.
Apply soil drenching @ 0.5 L/plant using microbial consortia during 6th month.
Apply soil drenching @ 0.5 L/plant using microbial consortia during 8th month.

papaya.content: Maintain 3-row maize border and use insect-proof nursery for vector and disease management.
Spray neem oil at 3% concentration for pest management.
Apply humic acid drenching @ 2 ml/L every 2 months.
Apply foliar spray containing ZnSO4 (5 g/L), boron (1 g/L), and urea (10 g/L) during 4th month.
Apply foliar spray containing ZnSO4 (5 g/L), boron (1 g/L), and urea (10 g/L) during 7th month.
Apply Jeevamruth drenching (200 L + oilcake extracts) @ 1 L/plant during 3rd month.
Apply Jeevamruth drenching (200 L + oilcake extracts) @ 1 L/plant during 5th month.
Apply Jeevamruth drenching (200 L + oilcake extracts) @ 1 L/plant during 8th month.
Apply Flonicamid 50 WG @ 75 g a.i./ha when required.
Use raised bed planting with drip fertigation and foliar micronutrients (Zn, B) to improve yield and fruit quality.

finger_millet.content: Apply FYM @ 3 t/ha, Azophos (2 kg/ha), Trichoderma (2.5 kg/ha), and vermicompost (1.5 t/ha).
Spray Panchagavya (3%) during grain filling stage.
Apply NSKE 5% and Bacillus subtilis 0.5% as needed for disease and pest management.
Apply 1.5% foliar formulation at flower initiation stage.

blackgram.content: Use nodule-associated plant probiotics containing beneficial microbes to improve nodulation, drought tolerance, and yield.
Apply foliar spray of tebuconazole + trifloxystrobin (1 g/L) or tebuconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L) at symptom appearance and again after 15 days for powdery mildew and Cercospora leaf spot management.

greengram_blackgram_redgram.content: Apply TNAU Liquid Pulse Wonder @ 5 kg/ha at peak flowering stage in greengram and blackgram.
Apply TNAU Liquid Pulse Wonder @ 5 kg/ha 15 days after flowering in redgram.
Prepare raised beds of 90 cm width with 30 cm furrows.
Treat seeds with Imidacloprid (5 ml/kg), Bacillus subtilis (10 g/kg), Rhizobium, and Phosphobacteria (30 g/kg).
Maintain spacing of 30 × 15 cm with drip irrigation and fertigation of 25:50:25:40 NPKS kg/ha.
Apply Pendimethalin + Imazethapyr as pre-emergence and Quizalofop-ethyl + Imazethapyr as early post-emergence herbicides.
Apply TNAU Vigour Plus seed coating @ 20-25 ml/kg to improve germination and seedling vigour.
Use Bio-Pulse microbial seed bio-priming formulation to improve yield under pathogenic stress.

greengram.content: Apply foliar spray of tebuconazole + trifloxystrobin (1 g/L) or tebuconazole 25 EC (1 ml/L) at symptom appearance and again after 15 days for powdery mildew and Cercospora leaf spot management.
Apply TNAU Vigour Plus pre-sowing seed coating containing IAA and GA to improve seed germination and seedling vigour.

groundnut.content: Apply TNAU Groundnut Rich @ 5.0 kg/ha at 35 DAS (50% flowering) using 500 litres of water.
Apply TNAU Groundnut Rich @ 5.0 kg/ha at 45 DAS during pod development using 500 litres of water.
Use Nut Boost seed inoculation containing phosphate, potash, and zinc solubilizing PGPRs to improve pod yield.

turmeric.content: Apply TNAU micronutrient mixture @ 15 kg/ha as enriched FYM with 50% basal application and 50% top dressing at 90 DAP.
